questions.question: Dozens of venues for which sport have recently announced closures across China following government directives?
questions.explanation: At least 18 golf courses in China are closing following official orders linked to the country's ongoing anti-corruption campaign.
questions.context: Anti-corruption campaign under Xi Jinping: At least 18 golf courses across China announce closures, including ten in Beijing, with many citing government orders following earlier restrictions on golf associated with paramount leader Xi Jinping's anti-corruption campaign.

questions.question: Coastguard units safely rescued 16 crew members after a oil tanker registered in Malta sank off the coast of which Spanish island?
questions.explanation: A rescue operation saved 16 sailors after their Maltese-flagged tanker foundered off Ibiza.
questions.context: One crew member is killed and 16 more are rescued after the sinking of a Malta-flagged tanker off the coast of Ibiza, Spain.

questions.question: A consortium led by the US firm Eldridge has agreed to buy the international operations of which major oil producer?
questions.explanation: American asset manager Eldridge leads a group acquiring the international assets of Russian energy company Lukoil.
questions.context: A business consortium led by U.S.-based asset management company Eldridge agrees to purchase international assets of Russian oil company Lukoil, including oil and gas fields, refineries, pipelines, and other infrastructure.

questions.question: An English court has convicted 32-year-old Anthony Williams of attempted murder following a series of attacks, including a knife incident on which train service?
questions.explanation: Anthony Williams was found guilty of multiple attempted murders, including stabbing passengers onboard an LNER train.
questions.context: 2025 Cambridgeshire train stabbing: The Cambridge Crown Court in the United Kingdom finds 32-year-old Anthony Williams guilty of the attempted murders of 14 people in three separate incidents, including the stabbing of ten people on a LNER train in November 2025.

questions.question: Which Spanish economist has been chosen to take over as the president of the European Central Bank following Christine Lagarde's resignation?
questions.explanation: Pablo Hernández de Cos was elected to lead the European Central Bank after the departure of Christine Lagarde.
questions.context: Spanish economist Pablo Hernández de Cos is elected as the new president of the European Central Bank, succeeding French lawyer Christine Lagarde after her resignation.
